newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine sunflower seed forecast down at 2.3 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine sunflower seed forecast down at 2.3 mln T.

text.p: Ukraine will produce about 2.3 million tonnes of sunflower seed this year, down from last year's figure of 2.86 million tonnes, Valentyn Tymoshenko, a senior Agriculture Ministry official said on Tuesday.
Ukraine has started its sunflower seed harvest, and yields from the first harvested fields stood at 1.16 tonnes per hectare, against 1.50 tonnes per hectare in 1995, Tymoshenko added.
At the beginning of the summer the Ukrainian government forecast this year's total sunflower seed output at 2.71 million tonnes.
Officials are blaming severe drought during the summer months.
Ukraine sowed 1.89 million hectares with sunflower seed this year, up from 1.80 million hectares in 1995.
According to the Agriculture Ministry this year's harvest will produce up to about 800,000 tonnes of sunflower oil, down from last year's figure of 1.2 million tonnes.
Ukraine's domestic sunflower oil needs amount to about 650,000 tonnes.
In the first six months of the year Ukraine's sunflower seed exports were worth $50 million.
